entities.summary: The Church of the Transfiguration and the Protection of Our Lady Queen of Poland colloquially the Piarist Church and Transfiguration Church is a Roman Catholic Piarist conventual church located at 4 Pijarska Street in the Old Town of Kraków, Poland.
